filter_corpus_openwebtext: filter an OpenWebText JSONL corpus by fixing text, detecting non-English documents, and removing small documents below 128 tokens
run_cleanup_dataset_cli: run the cleanup_dataset.py script with input and output filenames as command line arguments to clean OpenWebText data
fix_text_with_ftfy: fix malformed Unicode text in JSONL documents using ftfy library before language detection and tokenization
detect_non_english_documents: detect and skip non-English documents in a JSONL corpus using langdetect language detection
filter_small_documents: filter out small documents with fewer than 128 tokens using GPT-2 tokenizer for dataset cleanup
